Task 4: Inspection and Renovation Completion The inspection phase involved a series of activities to ensure that all systems, components and elements of the renovated space were functioning properly and met the required standards. This included thorough inspections, testing and verification of various aspects of the project to ensure compliance with codes, regulations and design specifications. It involved conducting inspections of electrical, plumbing, HVAC and other systems to ensure they are installed correctly and in accordance with applicable standards. Additionally, equipment and fixtures were tested to ensure proper functionality and performance. Overall, the inspection phase played a crucial role in ensuring that the renovated space is safe, functional and ready for use according to the intended design and specifications. Milestone 4.1: Inspection and Renovation Completion This milestone represented the final acceptance of the renovated space and components with the respective documentation. The renovation project was considered complete and ready for handover to the occupants. Deliverable 4.1 Inspection and Renovation Completion Work toward this milestone began in April and progressed according to the construction schedule provided by the General Contractor. Significant completion of inspections and documentation including electrical, water, and data occurred during Q3. The space was prepared to be handed over to occupants and the final closeout of inspection and renovation were completed shortly after the start of Q4. Occupancy began during August, and the space was prepared for full operation during Q4. Task 5: Furnishing and Equipment The objective was to provide the necessary tools and resources that support the specific needs and activities of the Center. This included workstations, desks, chairs, storage solutions, specialized lab equipment, computer systems, communication devices and other essential items. The scope involved considering factors such as current and future experiments and research, ergonomics, workflow efficiency and the aesthetic of the space. Properly furnishing and equipping the spaces ensures a comfortable and efficient workspace, promoting productivity, collaboration and the successful operation of the newly renovated facility. Milestone 5.1: Furniture and Storage This milestone represents the placement of furniture and storage for the lobby, conference room, Intelligent Energy Systems Lab, and office suite. The spaces were considered ready for standard operation upon completion. Deliverable 5.1 Furniture and Storage Furniture for the space was installed starting at the end of Q3, and the office suite and lab were prepared for standard operation during Q4. Breakroom appliances, storage, and other essential items were purchased after the handover to the occupants. Staff in the Center transitioned to working in the space after the milestone was completed at the start of Q5. Other essential items were purchased throughout Q5 and Q6. Milestone 5.2: Test and/or Design Equipment This milestone represented the placement of testing and/or design equipment for the office and lab spaces, including computers, server for data storage and wind tunnel instrumentation.
